# India Today

> > India's leading news and current affairs platform covering politics, elections, education, regional news, and investigative journalism across Indian states and international affairs.

India Today is a comprehensive news media outlet providing in-depth coverage of Indian politics (BJP, Congress, regional parties), state-level news across major cities (Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Chennai), education resources (CBSE/ICSE results, study abroad guides), and special events including the India Today Conclave series. The platform features investigative journalism, ground reports, and analysis of current affairs spanning elections, government policy, and socio-political developments.

## Key Topics

- Indian Elections & Political Coverage
- BJP and Regional Political Parties
- State News (Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, West Bengal, Karnataka, Maharashtra, Rajasthan)
- Education Resources (Board Exams, CBSE, ICSE, Study Abroad)
- India Today Conclave Events (Energy Summit, AI Robotics, Woman Summit)
- Investigative Journalism & Ground Reports
- Current Affairs & Government Accountability
- International Relations (Pakistan, Bangladesh, UAE)
- Local City News (Delhi, Bengaluru, Chennai, Mumbai)
- Assembly Elections Coverage
- Cricket & Sports Coverage
- Lifestyle & Cultural Trends

## Elections & Political Coverage

- [Mandate 2024](https://www.indiatoday.in/mandate-2024-election-news): 2024 election coverage: BJP, NDA, Congress, Maharashtra, Jharkhand polls
- [Desh Ka Neta Kaisa Ho - Lok Sabha 2024](https://www.indiatoday.in/elections/lok-sabha/desh-ka-neta-kaisa-ho): Lok Sabha 2024 campaign hub covering BJP, Kerala, West Bengal elections
- [States News](https://www.indiatoday.in/states): Indian states news: Haryana, Rajasthan, Telangana regional politics & crime

## Investigative & Feature Journalism

- [The Big Story](https://www.indiatoday.in/the-big-story): Investigative features: ECI, Rafale, India-China, government accountability
- [Cover Story](https://www.indiatoday.in/cover-story): Magazine cover stories: Iran-Israel conflict, India foreign policy, Nicobar
- [Ground Report](https://www.indiatoday.in/ground-report): Investigative ground reports: Bangladesh unrest, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman

## Education & Career Resources

- [Education Today](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today): Education hub: exam results, admissions, IIT Madras, job notifications
- [Board Exam Results 2025](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/results): CBSE, ICSE board exam results tracker for Class 10th & 12th across states
- [Engineering Courses in Canada](https://www.indiatoday.in/education-today/study-abroad-courses/canada/engineering-btech-mtech): BTech/MTech Canada study guide: eligibility, fees, PGWP, Express Entry

## India Today Conclave & Events

- [Conclave 2025](https://www.indiatoday.in/conclave-2025): India Today Conclave 2025 event hub featuring summits on energy, AI, UAE
- [Podcasts](https://www.indiatoday.in/podcasts): Cricket podcasts: IPL 2024, T20 World Cup, Ravindra Jadeja, Ajit Agarkar

## City & Regional News

- [Bengaluru News](https://www.indiatoday.in/cities/bengaluru-news): Latest Bengaluru local news, crime, education & Karnataka city updates
- [Chennai News](https://www.indiatoday.in/cities/chennai-news): Chennai local news: H5N1 outbreak, DMK politics, Tamil Nadu city updates

## Lifestyle & Culture

- [Trends](https://www.indiatoday.in/trends): Gen Z trends: spirituality, dating apps, Zerodha, workplace culture
- [Beauty Tips](https://www.indiatoday.in/lifestyle/beauty): Beauty trends, makeup tips, skincare, cosmetics & grooming articles
- [Korean Dramas](https://www.indiatoday.in/korean-dramas): K-dramas, K-pop, BTS news, Netflix Korean content & celebrity updates
- [History of IT](https://www.indiatoday.in/history-of-it): Indian history articles: 1971 war, Bangladesh liberation, military history
